name: foundation-awards-base
description: FAB is a system for managing Alpkit Foundation Awards
summary: Manages the entire Alpkit Foundation grant application process, helping staff handle hundreds of applications efficiently without relying on spreadsheets or manual emails. It organizes applications as easy-to-read files, collects trustee votes in shared spreadsheets, and automates sending outcome emails, making grant decisions smoother and less error-prone. This system is ideal for grant administrators who need to coordinate reviews and communicate results reliably.
